# Sensitivity analyses (generated by `python -m polysafe.sensitivity`)

PREREGISTRATION D8.1 and D9.2. Each analysis repeats only the primary comparison of D7.2 (reduced L2 logistic regression, clinical-only against clinical + medication; 5 folds x 10 repeats; BCa with 10,000 resamples). LightGBM is not repeated. **Which analyses are run was fixed before any model was fitted; how each is run and reported was fixed after the primary result was seen (D9.2).** No sensitivity analysis replaces the primary result; no test between analyses.

Primary result (D7.2, `results/models.md`): dAUROC +0.036 (95% BCa 0.006 to 0.071).

Groups: patients, except hospital clusters (stays linked by a shared hospital or patient). Coverage is read from the D2.1a simulation only where D8.1 names a simulated cohort (primary cohort; full cohort n = 868); otherwise not measured.
